ECOM E01GP-S+ 1-PON Port GPON OLT – Compact, High-Performance Fiber Access Solution

The ECOM E01GP-S+ GPON OLT is a compact and reliable optical line terminal designed for high-speed fiber access networks. Featuring 1 GPON PON port, 2 copper Gigabit Ethernet (GE) ports, and 1 uplink 10GE SFP+ port, this OLT is ideal for small-scale FTTH (Fiber to the Home) deployments, enterprise networking, or campus environments.

With its 240V AC single power supply and efficient design, the ECOM E01GP-S+ ensures consistent performance and low energy consumption. Designed and manufactured in China, this device delivers reliable performance backed by a 24-month limited warranty.

Key Features:

  • 1 × GPON PON Port – Supports up to 128 ONUs per port
  • 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps Copper GE Ports – For flexible local network integration
  • 1 × 10GE SFP+ Uplink Port – High-speed uplink to core networks
  • 240V AC Single Power Supply – Reliable and energy-efficient power support
  • Compact Design – Easy to deploy in space-constrained environments
  • Made in China – Built to international quality standards
